name: 'Fuzz'
on:
  pull_request:

    branches:

  merge_group:

    - cron: '30 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      fuzztime:
        description: 'How long to run each fuzz target for, as a Go duration'
        required: false
        default: '10m'
        type: 'string'
permissions:
  contents: 'read'
jobs:
  discover:
    name: 'Discover'
    runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.targets.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: 'Harden Runner'
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@aebdcf6156ab6691adf63218240e476564a1ed4c # v2.23.0
        with:
          egress-policy: 'audit'
      - name: 'Set up Go'
        uses: actions/setup-go@d8cbb8045d7f43706b9177cceb36c1f91a6644d5 # v7.1.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.4'
      - name: 'Checkout'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: 'Get Dependencies'
        run: |
          go get -v -t ./...
      - name: 'Targets'
        id: 'targets'
        run: |
          targets='[]'
          pkgs=$(go list ./...)

          for pkg in $pkgs; do
            listed=$(go test -list '^Fuzz' "$pkg")

            for target in $(printf '%s\n' "$listed" | grep '^Fuzz' || true); do
              targets=$(printf '%s' "$targets" | jq -c --arg package "$pkg" --arg target "$target" '. + [{package: $package, target: $target}]')
            done
          done

          printf '%s\n' "$targets" | jq -c '.'
          printf 'matrix=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$targets" | jq -c '{include: .}')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    name: 'Fuzz ${{ matrix.target }}'
    needs: 'discover'

      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover.outputs.matrix) }}

          egress-policy: 'audit'
      - name: 'Set up Go'
        uses: actions/setup-go@d8cbb8045d7f43706b9177cceb36c1f91a6644d5 # v7.1.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.4'
      - name: 'Checkout'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: 'Get Dependencies'
        run: |
          go get -v -t ./...
      # A pull request gets a short run, which is a smoke test of the targets themselves rather than a search. The
      # search is the nightly schedule, which starts from the corpus every previous nightly run left behind.
      - name: 'Duration'
        id: 'duration'
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          INPUT_FUZZTIME: ${{ inputs.fuzztime }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "${INPUT_FUZZTIME}" ]; then
            printf 'fuzztime=%s\n' "${INPUT_FUZZTIME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "${EVENT_NAME}" = 'schedule' ]; then

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
